stories.title: "L'opportunité d'écrire l'histoire du sport français" : Gabby Williams et l'équipe de France peuvent-elles renverser les Américaines pour leur première finale à la Coupe du monde de basket ?

en.title: "The opportunity to write French sports history": Can Gabby Williams and the French team overturn the Americans in their first World Cup basketball final?
en.summary: France's women's basketball team faces the United States in their first World Cup final on Sunday after defeating Germany in the semifinals. The matchup represents a chance for the French to avenge their loss to the Americans at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

stories.title: A Paris, sans billets mais motivés, les fans de Céline Dion organisent leurs contre-soirées karaoké

en.title: In Paris, without tickets but motivated, Céline Dion fans organize their own karaoke counter-events
en.summary: Hundreds of Céline Dion fans unable to secure tickets for her Paris concerts gathered in bars and lounges on September 12 to create their own celebration events.

stories.title: «On ne pourra pas gagner à gauche avec deux tiers des Français qui nous haïssent» : à la fête de l’Huma, Ruffin tacle implicitement Mélenchon

en.title: "We won't be able to win on the left with two-thirds of French people hating us": at the Huma festival, Ruffin implicitly attacks Mélenchon
en.summary: The Debout! presidential candidate criticized the left for scaring French voters and called for left-wing unity to counter the far right.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Guerre au Moyen-Orient : les rebelles houthis du Yémen disent avoir attaqué une base militaire en Arabie saoudite

en.title: LIVE - Middle East war: Yemen's Houthi rebels claim to have attacked a military base in Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pro-Iranian rebels in Yemen, who control the strategic Bab el-Mandab strait, reportedly launched an offensive against a Saudi military base.

stories.title: "Je vais bien" : Céline Dion émue, résiliente et ambitieuse, rassure son public lors de son retour sur scène

en.title: "I'm doing well": Céline Dion, moved, resilient and ambitious, reassures her audience upon her return to the stage
en.summary: The Quebec artist made her stage comeback, delivering a full performance despite the illness she has been managing.

stories.title: En Suède, le pas de deux des Libéraux avec l’extrême droite pourrait leur coûter cher

en.title: In Sweden, the liberals' dance with the far right could cost them dearly
en.summary: Sweden's far-right party, the Sweden Democrats, has influenced the policies and direction of the ruling center-right coalition. As general elections take place on September 13, the governing parties may face significant electoral consequences.

stories.title: Une grève de deux jours débute à Radio France pour dénoncer la chronique du directeur-adjoint de Valeurs actuelles

en.title: A two-day strike begins at Radio France to denounce the commentary of the deputy director of Valeurs actuelles
en.summary: Trade unions at Radio France have initiated a two-day strike, objecting to Charles Sapin's involvement with the public broadcaster, which they contend is incompatible with its public service mission.

stories.title: "Elle est top, elle va bien !" : les spectateurs subjugués à la sortie du premier concert de Céline Dion

en.title: "She's great, she's doing well!": spectators captivated at the exit of Céline Dion's first concert
en.summary: Fans of Céline Dion expressed enthusiasm after attending her 2.5-hour concert on Saturday evening, with France Télévisions capturing their reactions outside the venue.

stories.title: Retour sur scène de Céline Dion : "On a beaucoup pleuré, c'était très fort de A à Z"

en.title: Céline Dion's return to the stage: "We cried a lot, it was very powerful from start to finish"
en.summary: Céline Dion performed her first concert in six years near Paris on Saturday, delivering her greatest hits to an emotional crowd after a period marked by illness.

stories.title: "On a retrouvé sa voix, sa classe" : les fans de Céline Dion racontent son premier concert

en.title: "We found her voice, her class": Céline Dion fans recount her first concert
en.summary: Céline Dion performed her first concert in six years near Paris on Saturday, marking a comeback following years affected by illness, with fans expressing their emotional reactions to her return.

stories.title: Céline Dion interprète "My Heart Will Go On" lors de son premier concert à Paris

en.title: Céline Dion performs "My Heart Will Go On" at her first concert in Paris
en.summary: Céline Dion visibly emotional, began her first of 26 concerts near Paris on Saturday evening, marking her return after more than six years away, performing her "Titanic" theme song.

stories.title: Céline Dion fever grips Paris as fans prepare for comeback concerts

en.title: Céline Dion fever grips Paris as fans prepare for comeback concerts
en.summary: Céline Dion begins her first of 16 sold-out Paris concerts at Plenitude Arena on Saturday, with fans engaging in various activities to celebrate her return.

stories.title: OPINION. « Ce que nous choisissons de voir », par Ricardo Vita, initiateur de la démarche de décoration de Nicole Avant en France et trois autres signataires

en.title: OPINION. "What we choose to see", by Ricardo Vita, initiator of the decoration process for Nicole Avant in France and three other signatories
en.summary: France has honored Nicole Avant with the Legion of Honor. The opinion piece argues that by recognizing someone who highlighted overlooked historical figures, the Republic demonstrates how societies are built through the narratives and faces they choose to celebrate.

stories.title: OPINION. « Livraisons par drone : au-delà des craintes, les Français séduits par les bénéfices environnementaux »

en.title: OPINION. "Drone deliveries: beyond concerns, French people attracted by environmental benefits"
en.summary: While drone delivery raises some concerns, research indicates unexpected acceptance in France. Citizens recognize practical benefits, particularly in rural areas, beyond viewing it as merely futuristic technology.

stories.title: Déraillement d’un TER en Normandie : le mystère du rail présent sur la voie

en.title: Derailment of a TER train in Normandy: the mystery of the rail present on the tracks
en.summary: Investigators are examining whether a rail found on the tracks caused the accident in Normandy, exploring whether it resulted from negligence or deliberate sabotage.

stories.title: À la recherche du nouveau de Gaulle. La chronique de Guillaume Durand

en.title: In search of the new de Gaulle. The chronicle of Guillaume Durand
en.summary: Columnist Guillaume Durand examines an unlikely partnership between publisher Jean-Luc Barré and Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu, discussing France's direction amid budget challenges and national concerns.

stories.title: Israël : en campagne pour les législatives, Benyamin Netanyahou rattrapé par les alertes ignorées avant le 7-Octobre

en.title: Israel: while campaigning for legislative elections, Benjamin Netanyahu caught out by alerts ignored before October 7
en.summary: Haaretz reports that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu failed to respond to alerts before October 7, a revelation that may impact his campaign ahead of October 27 legislative elections.
